c: Negative Space instantly grants all of the planets summoned by Celestial Booster while additionally revealing secret planets (Planet X, Ceres, and Eris) that act as extra projectiles. Its Base Damage is slightly increased, with
reset to 1 as all the planets are always active and the weapon no longer benefits from it.
Every 15−5*(1−playerCooldown) seconds, all planets will become negative, gaining +10 Base Damage, and increased
for 5+1*playerDuration seconds. The orbits of each planet will tilt up, which can be slowly controlled by moving left or right to rotate the orbits clockwise or counterclockwise, respectively.
Negative Space's damage increases with the amount of gold the player has collected during that run:
10,000, Negative Space will gain 0.0005 Base Damage, per Gold collected, up to +5 Base Damage at
10,000, Negative Space's bonus base damage will follow the formula:
runCoins≡total amount of gold collected during the run
Effectively, Negative Space will gain another +2.5 Base Damage for every 100x increase in gold above

Upon evolving Celestial Booster into Negative Space, Outer Saboteur is removed from the passive slot and turns into Inner Saboteur, placed over the character's face and can still evolve other Ante Chamber DLC weapons. Obtaining Negative Space from a
will give the player the option of obtaining Outer Saboteur via a Level Up.
With Limit Break, Negative Space can be further leveled up.
See Combos for a list of all item interactions.
